comparison_metadata.principle: RAT uses CoT; CoT is expressed via RAT. One single system.
comparison_metadata.behavioral_equivalence_rule: Identical class names/imports do not imply identical runtime behavior. Headless harness and desktop runtime fulfill distinct architectural roles.
comparison_metadata.status: Verified against working tree and AST analysis; qwen_backend.py and modules/docai removed.

shared_implementation.algorithm: Dual predictor (RTR-style): Ridge regression for cost + LogisticRegression for accuracy per candidate (LADDER/REACT/PAL).

headless_harness_adapter.role: Offline batch fitting and evaluation on train/calibration/test splits with token cost accounting.
headless_harness_adapter.execution_mode: Batch replay over pre-computed or mock/real model embeddings and token counts.

desktop_rat_adapter.role: Imported EntryPredictor and EntryChoice symbols; integration is currently an uninstantiated stub in meta_reasoner.py.
desktop_rat_adapter.execution_mode: AST analysis confirms EntryPredictor/EntryChoice are imported at lines 21-22 but never instantiated or called. Desktop query intent currently relies on regex/keyword heuristics (is_reasoning_query) rather than the trained predictor.
desktop_rat_adapter.integration_gap: Identified gap: EntryPredictor needs proper online wiring into MetaReasoner in future backlog work.

shared_implementation.algorithm: Backward induction stopping policy with threshold fitting tau_0 (CoT) and tau_1 (SC) on calibrated confidence.

headless_harness_adapter.role: Offline threshold fitting on calibration split and offline policy replay.
headless_harness_adapter.execution_mode: research_study.fit_policies() fits stopping on calibration split with default n_bootstraps=0 (bootstrap CI disabled by default). Offline replay over pre-computed attempts via evaluate_records(); does not run online Gym episode loops.

desktop_rat_adapter.role: Holds OptimalStoppingPolicy instance with hardcoded thresholds for UI demonstration slice.
desktop_rat_adapter.execution_mode: Policy instantiated with hardcoded tau = [0.671, 0.688] (comment "Pre-fitted" has no reviewed run artifact evidence). In _solve_policy_with_ladder:335-347, initial confidence is hardcoded at 0.58 and compared directly to tau[0]; consensus (5/5) is synthesized text rather than an online call to should_escalate or 5-sample voting.
desktop_rat_adapter.integration_gap: Heuristic simulation slice for UI; real stopping calibration evidence and runtime ladder escalation remain core backlog.

shared_implementation.algorithm: Discrete action space representation and 3D/6D question complexity feature extraction.

headless_harness_adapter.role: Formal Gym environment definition, step transitions, action masking, and reward calculation (-lam*tokens + beta*conf_gain).
headless_harness_adapter.execution_mode: Episode rollouts and strategy evaluations against dataset ground truth.

desktop_rat_adapter.role: Strategy enum (A) and ladder definition (LADDER) sharing; complexity feature extraction.
desktop_rat_adapter.execution_mode: Direct execution of ladder rungs; does not instantiate Gym step loop online to minimize UI latency.

shared_implementation.algorithm: Model-agnostic parsing, answer extraction, safe AST arithmetic, and sandboxed python execution.

headless_harness_adapter.role: Benchmark scoring, regex extraction for GSM8K/MATH/SVAMP, self-consistency majority voting, sandboxed PAL verification.
headless_harness_adapter.execution_mode: Batch answer normalization and accuracy checking against gold labels.

desktop_rat_adapter.role: Real-time math evaluation (safe_calculate), code extraction and verification in VGC verifier, PAL execution in meta-reasoner.
desktop_rat_adapter.execution_mode: Interactive execution returning structured MetaReasoningResult for Qt PreviewPanel.
